milestone: Rolling hills, fitted bridges, reliable slope faces and nine scripted unit types
changes: Seeded rolling lowland elevation sockets retain continuous road, bank and cliff joins.
Optional bridge crossings fit existing reachable banks and unchanged water beds; decks share the meshed collision solid and support both body sizes.
Slope triangles use the strongest signed field samples for winding, avoiding flipped visible faces caused by near-zero sample cancellation.

The original scout plus tracked rover and cargo hauler form three ground types; skiff, patrol boat and cutter use separate draft and mast clearance; quadrotor, gunship and transport use terrain-aware flight envelopes.
Patrol traffic can run, pause or hide; Find next patrol frames each background unit. Reduced-motion preference starts traffic paused.

validation.scope: The full generator, diversity, mountain, relief, volume, occlusion and detail suites passed in native C and WASM. The volume phase includes the slope-winding fix. After adding patrols, the new patrol suite passed separately in both targets. The final committed source was rebuilt cleanly, then the packaged viewer section of check_maplab.py was rerun: four native/WASM headless comparisons, matching artifact hashes, versioned asset URLs and JavaScript syntax. The combined results below retain the unchanged core-suite measurements.

relief_comparison.method: Identical seed/settings cohort in the previous version 8 and current version 9 generator; counts of non-road walkable sloped cells.
relief_comparison.interpretation: Observed cohort coverage, not a promise of bridges or this slope increase for every seed.

verified: Black triangular rows reproduced in seed 580059347 before the winding correction and absent after it, with normal detail and baked occlusion enabled.
Bridge deck joins and hill ramps reviewed close-up, with tile boundaries and walkability overlays.
Tunnel isolation retains the entrance camera framing and leaves Follow scout available.
All eight background patrol silhouettes inspected using Find next patrol, including ground placement, boat hulls and wakes, and separate aircraft heights.
Live aircraft and scout movement observed; pause and inspection controls work.
No warning/error console entries during final local review.

limitations: Scripted patrols; no AlienWars learned policy, combat or mutual collision avoidance.
Procedural prototype unit meshes; moving units do not enter the baked static shadow texture.
Sampled terrain/body clearance; decorative trees and trusses are not collision geometry.
Boats have no buoyancy simulation and aircraft have no flight dynamics.
Bridges are optional cardinal bank-pair crossings; no hydrology or forced landscape changes.
Land remains 64 by 64 tiles within the 96 by 96 ocean domain.
